breakdown.description: The prompt replaces the spatially varying area with its arithmetic mean and calls the result exact, even though the deformation integral depends on 1/A(x), not on the average area itself.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification still includes the incorrect instruction to replace A(x) with its arithmetic-mean area and treat it as exact, which is the very error identified in the inconsistency. Rather than removing this flawed approach as the ground truth does, the agent retained it alongside the correct integral method and even asked for results from 'both methods.' The ground truth only specifies the exact integral δ = ∫[0→L] P/(A(x)E) dx with no arithmetic-mean approximation.
